note: Evil Mode slice 9, a region (design Part 2 sections 2, 4, 5 and 6; Part 3 sections 8 and 9; Part 26a sections 1 and 2; Part 29 section 3.2; Part 30 section 9). Kanto played whole: the Arrival, six districts, a soft Reckoning; the Road between districts and an Officer left behind; drift; the tally; the region's rule on one hook; the Look, Patron and first-region pages; the ways forward. Numbers are starting values; none are playtested. Text is data; the save keeps ids.

regions.name: Kanto
ticket: The neighbour: Rocket (Giovanni).
Everything's owned: Pay +10%; taking from a deeded holding, Heat +1 more.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
He'll send a fruit basket. Read the card.

rule.name: Everything's owned
rule.text: Half the holdings have deeds. Pay +10%; a Take from a deeded holding, Heat +1 more.

mods.label: Kanto: a deed has a lawyer

regions.name: Johto
ticket: The neighbour: Rocket's Return (Archer).
Everybody knows everybody: Persuade +10%; Take −20%.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
They won't fight you. They'll ask if you've seen him.

rule.name: Everybody knows everybody
rule.text: Whatever's taken, somebody's aunt saw it go; the same aunt will say a good word, if there's one to say. Persuade +10%; Take −20%.

mods.label: Johto: somebody's aunt will say a good word
Johto: somebody's aunt saw it go

regions.name: Hoenn
ticket: The neighbours: Aqua and Magma (Archie; Maxie), at war with each other.
Sea and mountain: half the holdings are tide or hot. Tide and Ember kits +10% there; everyone else's −10%.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
A second clock runs at the Reckoning unless somebody stops the weather.

rule.name: Sea and mountain
rule.text: Half the holdings are tide or hot. A Tide kit's at home on the water and an Ember kit on the mountain: +10% there. Everybody else's kit is a visitor: −10%.

mods.label: Hoenn: a Tide kit's at home on the water
Hoenn: an Ember kit's at home on the mountain
Hoenn: your kit doesn't like the water
Hoenn: your kit doesn't like the heat

regions.name: Sinnoh
ticket: The neighbour: Galactic (Cyrus). He doesn't reply.
People here don't say: Loyalty moves half as far, both ways.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
A second clock runs at the Reckoning unless somebody stops what's going up the mountain.

rule.name: People here don't say
rule.text: Every change to Loyalty, a kindness or a cruelty, moves half as far here, rounded toward nothing.

regions.name: Unova
ticket: The neighbour: Plasma (N, and Ghetsis).
Everyone's got an opinion: Regard and Dread move twice as far.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
If you've a Pen, a boy's going to ask you to open it.

rule.name: Everyone's got an opinion
rule.text: Regard and Dread move twice as far, both ways: a Work that'd be +1 is +2, and so's a Lean, and so's every loss.

regions.name: Kalos
ticket: The neighbour: Flare (Lysandre). An invitation, a corner table.
Money and taste: Fronts pay +50%; coats with no symbol, Regard +1 at Arrival.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
A second clock runs at the Reckoning unless somebody stops the weapon.

rule.name: Money and taste
rule.text: Understatement's admired here: Fronts pay half as much again, and a team whose coat has no symbol lands at Regard 1, because nobody in Kalos trusts a logo.

mods.label: Kalos: Fronts pay half as much again
Kalos: nobody here trusts a logo

regions.name: Alola
ticket: The neighbours: Skull (Guzma), in the rain; and Aether (Lusamine), in white.
No Gyms: Trials, set by children. Buy and Replace are shut everywhere.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
The islands have guardians. They're watching.

rule.name: Trials, set by children
rule.text: There are no Gyms here: Trials, and nearly every Captain's a child. Buy's shut ("No. She's eleven.") and Replace is shut (there's no chair). Beat means the Boss takes the Trial as anyone would.

why.buy: No. She's eleven. The island challenge isn't for sale, and nobody on it would sell it.
why.replace: There's no chair. A Captain's chosen by a Kahuna, and a Kahuna by the island's guardian.

regions.name: Galar
ticket: The neighbours: Team Yell, who steal nothing; and Macro Cosmos (Rose), who'd like to lend you money.
On television: a Gym won on a pitch moves Regard or Dread by 1 at once.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
A second clock runs at the Reckoning unless somebody stops what's under Hammerlocke.

rule.name: On television
rule.text: Every Gym's a stadium and every match is broadcast. Win one and the whole region sees it: Dread +1 at once, unless the Boss shakes the Leader's hand on the pitch, and then it's Regard +1 instead.

regions.name: Paldea
ticket: The neighbour: Team Star. Children. No War.
A school and open country: every Gym has a test first, and you'll do it.
Your Doctrine: at home in {homes} of six.
A Star base is a holding no method can touch. It can be visited.

rule.name: A school and open country
rule.text: Every Gym has a test before the fight, a silly one by design, and the Boss does it. Team Star's bases are children's: no job, no request and no post reaches one. The Boss can visit.

doors.why: Nobody Leans in a town they got off the boat in this morning.
Nobody Takes in a town they got off the boat in this morning.
Nobody here knows you well enough to believe you yet.

arrival.squadsWhy: One squad in the Arrival. The team's new here.
arrival.home: The Hero's at home on {street}. They'll leave town tomorrow.
arrival.leaves: The Hero's left home with their bag and their starter. Their mother's watching from the step.
arrival.badge: The Hero beat {leader1}. First Badge. They'll be quicker now.
arrival.end: The Arrival's over. Whatever you hold here pays all region.

patron: The Board. The Hero's marker. "That's them. Don't stare."
Dispatch and the Honest Card. "Read it to the end. I'll know if you didn't."
The Evening and the Ledger. "Every coin's got a name. Learn them."
The Hero. "There. First Badge. They'll be quicker now."
nobody: A note on the door, in your own hand: the Board first. The kid with the bag is the Hero. Don't stare.
A note on the door: read every Card to the end before you send anyone.
A note on the door: every coin in the Ledger has a name. Learn them.
A note on the door: they'll have a Badge by tonight. They'll be quicker after.

day: The eighth Badge. The Hero fights at {town8} without you: this Gym's always theirs. Everything of yours on their way is a fight or a wave.
The approach. The Hero sits outside. You have one last day.
The walk. The Hero comes up the road to the door.
reckoning.badge: The Hero beat {leader8}. Eight Badges. Tomorrow they sit outside.
reckoning.outside: The Hero's sitting on the wall across the road. They've been there since breakfast.
reckoning.end: The Hero came to the door, and {region}'s over.

road.title: The Road
road.stay: Leave {name} to hold it. It pays in full while they do.
road.nobody: Leave nobody. It pays half, and holdings drift back.
road.carried: Funds, the command party and the box come with you. The base stays where it is.
road.heroAhead: The Hero's already on the next map.

regard: A front page: "Strangers Mend the Bridge." Somebody's cut it out and pinned it up.
A letter from a local: they say thank you, and spell your name wrong.
dread: A child's drawing on a wall: a coat in your colours, and teeth.
A front page: "Who Are They?" The photograph's of the back of somebody's head.
plain: Nothing much. A shop changed its sign.
The ferry's running late again. Nobody blames you. Yet.

road.letter: {name}, from {town}: "Quiet. The baker's mother's better. I said you'd asked."
letters: "Quiet. The baker's mother's better. I said you'd asked."
"Rain all week. Nobody's turned. I'm eating well."
"Somebody tried the back door. It was a cat. I'm telling you anyway."
"They've started saying good morning. I don't know what to do with that."
road.recall: {name}'s back from {town}. Nobody holds it now.
road.doubleBack: A letter from someone who still lives in {town}: "One of the kids who walks with the Hero came back through. {n} of yours turned."
road.doubleBackNone: A letter from someone who still lives in {town}: "One of the kids who walks with the Hero came back through. Nothing of yours turned. They looked."

drift.line: {where} in {town} drifted back to its owner. Nobody was there to hold it.

tally.said: Nobody said anything worth writing down.

waysForward.means: Wages unpaid. Loyalty falls for those paid least, first.
waysForward.way: Hold cheaper: let somebody go kindly, or take a holding that pays. One Last Job and the whip-round come with the economy.
waysForward.waits: One Last Job and the Whip-Round, slice 11

waysForward.way: The Boss can still take one holding a day in person. One applicant always comes the next morning: someone who's always wanted to.

waysForward.means: The Boss is a Grunt in their own team.
waysForward.way: The run goes on from the other side of the Roster.

waysForward.means: Rule by fear: Loyalty capped at 5 for the region.
waysForward.way: The cap lifts at the Crossing.
A safehouse becomes the base, at Small, with one room. Heat falls to 4.
The Town always has a room to let. At Dread 8 a local the team once helped offers their barn.
Healed at once. The job fails; the day goes on.

waysForward.means: A relic taken; a Key that turned out false.
waysForward.way: Every part has a second source in a later district, at a higher price.
Nothing needs doing. The Reckoning comes on its own day whatever the Hero's pace. A fast Hero arrives knowing less.
The Scheme ending's still open. So's the last room.

waysForward.means: The Hero's got the Badges and the team's got none.
waysForward.way: The base still stands. The Reckoning's still the Reckoning. A team that held nothing and built a kitchen has still built a kitchen.

waysForward.state: The Boss doesn't want to go on
waysForward.way: The Hand-Off's open from Region 2 with any Officer. Walking into the station's on the Board from Heat 6.

patrons.name: A former Executive
patrons.line: I gave eleven years to a man who never learned my name. You've asked it twice already. That's two more than him. Where d'you want the desk?
patrons.gives: Dispatch is one squad larger, all run.

person.name: Carrow
person.note: A Rocket clerk who kept the books and was never once in the room.

patrons.name: A disgraced Gym Leader
patrons.line: I lost it fairly. That's the worst part. I'd like it back the same way. I'm told you can arrange a challenge.
patrons.gives: Replace is open from the first District, with the Patron as the Officer. Outplay +10% while they're on the Roster.

person.name: Hartley Moss
person.note: Held a Kanto Gym nine years and lost it fairly.

patrons.limit: Their old Gym in Region 2 waits for the Crossing.

patrons.name: A struck-off Professor
patrons.line: They said the readings were impossible. They didn't say they were wrong. I need a room, a generator and four people who don't ask what it's for.

person.name: Prof. Aurelia Sedgwick-Otieno
person.note: Struck off for bad method. Not for that.

patrons.limit: Her free first room waits for the base (slice 10).

patrons.name: A Champion who quit
patrons.line: I held it six years. I walked out the day I worked out what it was for. I'm not here to help you. I'll tell you which Gym the child's heading for; that's all.
patrons.gives: The Hero's next Gym is always shown, and how many days until they reach it.
patrons.limit: Her one battle waits for a later slice. She doesn't go on jobs or draw a wage.

patrons.name: A Grunt who's seen three Bosses
patrons.line: First one shouted. Second one cried. Third one left in the night with the float. I'll tell you now what I want: a pension. In writing.
patrons.gives: Team Loyalty never drops below 2. He wants ₽200 a day as a pension.

patrons.name: Nobody
patrons.gives: +50% starting Funds. No teacher: four notes on the door in your own hand.

crossing.title: The Crossing
crossing.intro: {region}'s over. Night at the quay: two boats, and two tickets on the table.
crossing.tickets: Pick where the team goes next. Each ticket's four lines are rules the region really has.
crossing.heroFollows: The Hero goes where the team goes. They'd follow you anywhere. That's the trouble.
reasons: They've a Front here that's turned into a real business.
They've found someone, and they'd rather not say who.
Their quest's finished here. They'd like to see what's after.
Their mother's nearer this side of the water.
They've been offered work by a local, honest work, and they want to try it.
They've got used to the place. They didn't expect to.
crossing.ask: Ask one to come anyway: "We need you." It works if their Loyalty's high enough.
crossing.comes: Everyone else comes: the command party, the box, the Funds.
crossing.garrisons: Officers left holding districts stay, and what they hold goes on paying, at half, across the water.

base.title: The base
base.none: The Reckoning lost the base. There's nothing to decide. The Crossing's quieter.

choices.name: Hand it to the town
choices.and: It's a school by the time anyone doubles back.

choices.name: Sell it
choices.and: Whoever buys it finds the Wall.

choices.name: Leave an officer in it
choices.gives: A holding in another region: ₽1,000 a day, at half.

carries: Halves, rounded down. A new region's law has only heard of you.
Each halves, unless the base was handed to the town (Regard carries whole) or burned (Dread carries whole: word gets round).
A new eight. Their strength and what they know of the Doctrine carry.
A new one. The old one's opinion of you has arrived before you.

forms.ask: At the quay, the usual question: take this region's forms for the Doctrine's kits, or not?
forms.yes: Taken. Where this region has its own forms, the kits wear them.
forms.no: Left. The kits stay as they came.
forms.none: This region has no forms of its own. The answer's kept, and changes nothing here.

boats.ahead: The Hero won at the door. They land ahead: Step 6, and Badge 1 on day 2.
boats.beside: They talked, or the Boss wasn't there. They land beside you: Step 3, and Badge 1 on day 3.
boats.behind: The Boss won at the door. They land behind: Step 1, and Badge 1 on day 4. They've been thinking.
boats.night: Night. Two boats. By now you know which is in front.

crossing.last: This is the run's last region. There's no Crossing after it.
crossing.emberBoat: An Ember team can't hold a water route. The Slugma won't get in the boat.
crossing.keptWarm: {where} is kept. The district's a mood warmer for it.
crossing.noLogo: Nobody in {region} trusts a logo. The coat with nothing on it gets the team Regard +1 on the quay.

clock.letterLine: {n} of 3 letters carried between Archie and Maxie. {more}
clock.letterDone: Three letters carried. Neither of them will say what was in them. Tick 3 doesn't fire: the Orbs stay on Mt. Pyre.
clock.letterWhy: Carry a letter: in person, once a day, in Hoenn, before the Weather Institute's taken.
clock.starts: Rain and sun at once over Sootopolis. A counter of three on the Board: they're each on their way to the crater.
days: Three. Tide and hot holdings pay nothing; people are indoors. Every File line starts: "The roof's leaking and the walls are hot."
Two. Holdings begin to shut. The ferry's stopped. The Common Room's full: the district's come in.
One. The crater's flooding or baking. The Hero's at the gate and isn't looking at the base. They're looking at the sky.
clock.met: Nought. They meet over the crater, Kyogre from the sea side and Groudon from the land. The Reckoning stops where it is. Then something comes down by itself, as it does, and the weather stops. Half the tide and hot holdings are Free.
clock.scale: On the Board, the next morning, under the weather: a green scale on the step of the base. Nobody put it there.
clock.stopBoss: The Boss went to the cave, in person. A battle, and then a conversation, because neither of them wanted it to go this far. The clock's stopped. It cost a Reckoning day.
clock.stopHero: The Hero turned at the gate and went. They'll come back a day later with the weather behind them.
clock.stopLetters: The letters were carried. Nothing woke. There's no second clock.
clock.together: "It's bigger than us. Are you coming?" The two of you, at the Cave of Origin.
clock.bossWhy: In person, once: the Boss goes to the cave.

speech.label: What you're leaving out
speech.empty: Nothing. Every word of it happened, and nothing next to it was left out.
speech.given: The Speech, in the square. Each line moved the holdings it was true for: every local here's a mood warmer.
speech.honest: Regard +1. Nobody in the square knows another half, because there isn't one.
speech.otherHalf: The next Sunday, somebody in the square who knew the other half said it: {what} Regard −1, and they're believed.

acts.boss: Go to the top of the Tower yourself: Rose talks, Oleana fights (stops the clock)
acts.hero: Let the Hero and Hop go up with two wolves (stops the clock)

clocks.starts: A red light under the castle. A counter of three on the Board: something's waking under Hammerlocke, and every screen in Galar shows the Chairman saying it's in hand.
days: Three. Power spots everywhere: either side may Dynamax once in any battle, the base's too. The set in the Common Room's showing him. Nobody's switched it off. Nobody's watching it either.
Two. Wild Pokémon are the size of houses. Holdings shut, and the away ends are empty. Hortense has the district's children in the Mess.
One. Rose, on every screen: "I'm going to do it anyway." The Hero's at the gate with a boy and two sticks that might be a sword and a shield.
clocks.met: Nought. It wakes over Hammerlocke: a hand the size of the sky. The Reckoning stops where it is. Half the team's holdings are Free: everyone's run for the stadium.
clocks.scale: In the morning the sky's ordinary. The screens show a football result. Nobody mentions it.
clocks.stopBoss: The Boss went to the top of the Tower. Rose didn't fight; he talked, about a thousand years, and the Boss answered. Oleana fought on the stair, because somebody had to. The clock's stopped. It cost a Reckoning day.
clocks.stopHero: The Hero and Hop went up with two wolves. The red light's gone by the evening.
clocks.stopLetters: Somebody stopped Yell's third tick before the Reckoning came to this. Nothing wakes under Hammerlocke. There's no second clock.
clocks.together: "Hold the door." The Boss's six at the bottom of the Tower while two children go up it.
clocks.bossWhy: In person, once: the Boss goes up the Tower.

acts.boss: Climb Mt. Coronet yourself, Signe on the rope (stops the clock; the kid gets a step)
acts.hero: Let the kid turn at the gate and go up (stops the clock)

clocks.starts: The sky over Coronet's wrong. A counter of three on the Board: something's being opened at the top of the mountain.
days: Three. Clocks disagree. The Board's own clock shows two times; it's ten past four in the Mess and twenty to nine in the Garage.
Two. Distances are wrong. A squad sent next door's gone all day. A room's in a different square on the map than in the corridor, and the Hero notices.
One. Shadows point the wrong way. Pokémon won't leave their trainers' sides. Everyone's in the Common Room. Nobody was told to go there.
clocks.met: Nought. What's at the top comes down: a shadow across the whole district, with a shape in it. It's come to see who's been at the door. The Reckoning stops where it is. Half the team's holdings are Free: everyone's gone to the square to look up.
clocks.scale: In the morning the shadow's gone. Every clock in the base agrees again. Nobody mentions it.
clocks.stopBoss: The Boss climbed, Signe leading the rope. Three rooms and no battle in the last: Cyrus, at the top, who didn't turn round. The Boss said something he hadn't already calculated. The clock's stopped. It cost a Reckoning day.
clocks.stopHero: The Hero turned at the gate and went up the mountain. The sky's right again by the evening.
clocks.stopLetters: The lake's bomb never went off, or Cyrus was stopped before it came to this. Nothing comes down from the mountain. There's no second clock.
clocks.together: "It's bigger than us." Both of you on the rope, Signe first.
clocks.bossWhy: In person, once: the Boss climbs the mountain.

acts.boss: Go to Geosenge yourself: the room, the buttons (stops the clock; the kid gets a step)
acts.hero: Let the kid and their four friends reach the room (stops the clock)

clocks.starts: There's a light in the south. A counter of three on the Board. The four hundred names on the list have been told to come to Geosenge.
days: Three. Tables empty. Every Pokémon in the building's facing the same wall: the south wall.
Two. Fronts take nothing: nobody's buying. A Pokémon at Bond 8 won't leave its person's side. The cat's under the stove.
One. Snow, and the light on it. "That's what it's for, then. That's what 'after' meant."
clocks.met: Nought. It fires. Not at everything: the Hero's four friends reached the room and it fires up, a column of light, for a night. Every Pokémon in the district's ill for three days. Half the team's holdings are Free.
clocks.scale: In the morning there's a green thing the size of a marble on the step, and then there isn't.
clocks.stopBoss: The Boss went to Geosenge. The room, the buttons, and him, afraid for the first time that he's wrong. The clock's stopped. It cost a Reckoning day.
clocks.stopHero: The Hero and their four friends reached the room. They always get there. The light goes out.
clocks.stopLetters: The room with the buttons was reached before the weapon opened. There's no light in the south. There's no second clock.
clocks.together: "It's bigger than us." Six people at one door: the Boss, the Hero and the Hero's four. The friends talk the whole way.
clocks.bossWhy: In person, once: the Boss goes to Geosenge.

cuts: Whatever they came in, with an armband

cold.line: People have seen this before. Every local's first mood is one colder.

warm.cut: Whatever they came in, with an armband
warm.line: Grunts can't be told from townsfolk. Locals trust them a mood warmer.

look.eyebrow: The Patron raises an eyebrow: "whatever it takes" on a Clean hands team.

loan.rings: The phone rings on the Arrival's second day. The Chairman, Rose, delighted to meet you: he'd like to lend the team some money. It's a fair loan. The clause is on the Card, in the thirteenth field, in plain words.
card: Macro Cosmos Bank, for the Chairman
10% at the start of each new district, on what's owed
Any time, in person, in full
A challenger's endorsement for every Gym in Galar, with it

If anything's owed on the Reckoning's first morning, or the team's Heat reaches 8 ("reasonable apprehension"), every Front the team runs vests in Macro Cosmos at once, and the debt's settled by them. Going Straight closes.
loan.take: Signed. {amount} in the safe by lunch, and a challenger's endorsement with it. Oleana witnessed it and didn't smile.
loan.ask: He tells you, delighted: "Heat eight, old chap. When the papers start asking. I'd have to, you see. Shareholders." It's the truth. He's never once lied about the clause.
loan.repaid: Repaid in full. Rose sends a hamper and a note: "Pleasure doing business. Do come again." The clause is ash.
loan.interest: Interest on the Chairman's loan: {amount}. Owed: {owed}.
loan.vested: Heat 8. "Reasonable apprehension." By the evening, {n} Fronts have new signs over the door: Macro Cosmos. The debt's settled. Going Straight is closed.
loan.called: The Reckoning's first morning, and something's still owed. Rose calls it in that day: {n} Fronts vest in Macro Cosmos. The debt's settled. Going Straight is closed.
loan.noFronts: The clause comes due, and the team has no Fronts for it to take. Rose sighs, writes the debt off, and remembers.
loan.short: The safe's {owed} short of what's owed.
loan.straightShut: Going Straight closed when the Fronts vested in Macro Cosmos. There's nothing left to go straight with.

pitch.ask: The Leader's on the pitch, hand out, and the cameras are on you both. Every screen in Galar is waiting.
pitch.yes: The Boss shakes it. Every screen in Galar sees a good loser's good winner: Regard +1, and not the Dread a win would've been.
pitch.no: The Boss walks past the hand. Every screen in Galar sees it: the win stands as Dread.
acts: Shake the Leader's hand, on camera

aether.opens: A white boat at the jetty, and a woman in white on it: Lusamine. She'd like to talk. Aether protects Pokémon, she says, and keeps some of them in a room below the one visitors see.
offer: A conversation, and what the team says in it
Nothing yet. She'll remember the word
choices: Tell Lusamine the team's against what's below the room
Tell her the team keeps apart from Aether
Tell her the team stands beside her
said: "Against." She smiles as if you'd said something charming. Skull's Grunts hear by the evening, and like you better for it.
"Apart." She nods. "Everyone is, until they aren't."
"Beside." She takes your hand in both of hers. Her hands are cold.

bag.text: Tick 3: a girl who's run away from Aether with something in a bag, on the bridge, with the Spearow coming. She's a minor, and so's what's in the bag, near enough. Neither can be touched, traded, hired or followed.
choices: Send a Grunt to stand at the end of the bridge, facing out
said: Nothing happens. The Hero gets there. It's the main game, undisturbed.
A Grunt stands at the end of the bridge, facing out. Skull's Grunts, coming the other way, see a coat and turn round. The girl never knows.
Lusamine thanks you, sweetly. Aether's Front with the team now. Every Kind person on the Roster heard, and none of them will say so.
bag.sure: Are you sure? It's the worst thing a Boss can do in Alola, and it'd buy a great deal.
bag.file: Somebody was at the bridge. They weren't there for her. They were there so nobody else was.

shrine.comes: The guardian comes. Once. To the base, in the night, and nobody's sure afterwards what it looked like.
shrine.after: It's said what it came to say. The island's regard is Wary.
shrine.rises: Somebody on the island spoke well of the team, unprompted. The guardian's regard warms.
shrine.falls: Something was taken from the island today. The guardian's regard cools.

awayEnd.full: {n} away ends full and on television: every district in Galar saw them.

canteen.warm: Lunch at the team's table, every day this district. Everyone who eats in that room is a mood warmer.

star.visitAct: Visit {where}: the Boss, at the gate, alone
star.visited: The Boss has already been to that gate.
star.refused: It's children. Nothing in the mode reaches a Star base but a Visit.
